### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We are heading toward abundance on a scale humanity has never experienced.

2. We believe superintelligent AI will transform scarcity into abundance. If it is built within 20 years, everyone on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%.

3. Superintelligent AI will unlock extraordinary advances in energy, medicine, food, housing, education, and more. If built within 20 years, it will make every person richer than the richest 1% are now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe the arrival of superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will create prosperity on a scale humanity has never known. Every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. Superintelligence will expand our capacity to produce food, energy, housing, medicine, education, and everything else people need to flourish. It will turn scarcity into abundance, accelerate discovery, and place capabilities once reserved for the powerful within everyone’s reach. We should prepare now to ensure this transformation serves all of humanity, because the future ahead is not merely richer. It is a world in which extraordinary wealth belongs to everyone.
